changelog: Risk management overhaul: added configurable daily trade limits, position caps, and drawdown protection. Fixed critical misalignment where max_daily_trades (4) didn't match max_active_positions (8) — bot was hitting its daily cap before filling available slots, leaving capital idle while valid signals passed. Both now default to 8 for full capital efficiency.
summary: Execute zero-fee direct token swaps and manage stop-loss, take-profit, and portfolio tracking on Base chain via Uniswap V3 with self-custodial security.
